name: update-progress-downloading
description: S→C update.progress push (protocol 1.8, SPEC §7, D-09/D-10): the mid-flight shape — stage `downloading` with `pct` and `version` present and no `error`. `downloading` is the ONLY stage that carries `pct` (D-10); the other six stages have no byte count, so a percentage would be invented. Non-terminal: `verifying`, `installing` and `restarting` follow.
